positions.title: Software Engineer (Backend & Cloud Infrastructure)
positions.description:
Designed and developed .NET backend systems and GCP infrastructure for VR-based clinical products. Established a scalable microservice architecture designed to accelerate feature delivery and ensure high availability for a scaling healthcare platform.

• Developed backend APIs to process session telemetry from VR headsets, and implemented data integrations between internal systems and Zoho CRM to support customer success operations.
• Mitigated microservice operational sprawl by automating deployments via GitHub Actions CI/CD and standardizing code patterns using repository templates and shared libraries to converge codebase variance and accelerate release cadence.
• Built and evolved the Terraform architecture that let our 4-person engineering team build, deploy, and operate 5 customer environments end to end through centralized Terraform development with state and service accounts isolated per customer and environment.
• Defined GCP IAMroles and policies to enforce least-privilege access, beginning the technical roadmap to secure cloud infrastructure for HITRUST r2 compliance.
• Expanded system observability by developing GCP Cloud Monitoring and Looker BI dashboards; prototyped an OpenTelemetry solution to trace latency and internal retry metrics across Pub/Sub and Firestore.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Core · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Terraform

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported backend systems for Microsoft’s consumer websites, focusing on feature development, performance optimization, and process automation.

• During the Windows 11 announcement livestream, resolved a fault in the hosting web app cascading into an upstream gateway outage; analyzed crash dumps and decompiled vendor libraries to trace it to a synchronous flush that blocked indefinitely.
• Migrated OS/browser targeting logic on the Microsoft Edge download site from legacy User-Agent string parsing to the modern Client Hints API, ensuring accurate content delivery while supporting anti-fingerprinting privacy standards.
• Improved website performance by optimizing data queries and caching strategies, reducing average page load times.
• Automated deployment with Python and Azure ARM templates, increasing reliability and reducing manual errors.

positions.title: Research Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project: AR/VR for Stroke Rehabilitation Research

• Developed an AR/VR gamified rehabilitation experience in Unity that implements real-time physical action tracking to improve stroke recovery outcomes.
• Engineered the telemetry ingestion pipeline for a published clinical study (n = 5), validating the system’s usability and error-tolerance for patients with motor deficits.

positions.title: Makerspace Staff
positions.description:
• Taught and enabled other people to use Makerspace equipment
• Provided assistance and feedback to projects in the Makerspace
• Planned and executed workshops on Arduino and VR

positions.title: Software Systems Development
positions.description:
• Developed an interface between a Myo gesture control armband and Arduino using Python to control a 3D-printed prosthetic hand.
• Integrated Bluetooth 4.0 communication between the Myo armband and a Raspberry Pi to process electromyography (EMG) muscle signals into servo commands.
